name: The Attic: A Mystery Puzzle Game
storyline:
Your brother has left for university and the attic where he kept all his things - and spent most of his time - is now yours. Very quickly you realize something's off. Matt was hiding something. Who's Destiny and why is this the first time you've ever heard that name?

Help Jess to organize, repair and restore retro objects - cassettes, cartridges, cameras - while you solve riddles and puzzles hidden in an attic full of memories. A cozy story with hints of mystery where you'll unveil who Matt really was and who Destiny was.
summary:
The Attic is an adventure in which you'll have to solve riddles, puzzles, and repair objects from the ‘80s and ‘90s to unveil the secret your brother and his mysterious friend, Destiny, were hiding.

Hideouts, secret spots, locked chests, mysterious videogame cartridges… A cozy adventure with hints of mystery inspired by escape rooms and the classic point-and-click adventure games.
